title: Palace: Marcos admin shares public sentiment vs reallocated 2027 funds
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. shares the public’s sentiment against the reallocation of 2027 funds originally earmarked for the administration’s key projects, Malacañang said on Friday.
